name: rosetta-determine-if-a-string-is-collapsible
code:
use default

collapsed(text: string) -> Ghul.Pipes.Pipe[char] is
    let previous: char? mut = null

    for ch in text do
        if !previous? \/ ch != previous then
            yield ch
        fi

        previous = ch
    od
si

collapse(text: string) -> string =>
    collapsed(text) |> map(c => "{c}") |> join("")
